gob.record_schema: CodecCompatibilityRecord (ID uint64, Key string unique, Category string index, Name string, Revision int)

category.order: bbolt key order (byte-ordered by index key)

aes.v5_constructor: aes.NewAES(json.Codec, key) where key is a fixed 16-byte AES-128 test key (not a production secret)
aes.record_schema: CodecCompatibilityRecord (ID uint64, Key string unique, Category string index, Name string, Revision int)

category.order: bbolt key order (byte-ordered by index key)

aes.bytes_nondeterministic_reason: AES-GCM uses crypto/rand for nonce generation. Raw ciphertext bytes differ per generation. Semantic decoding with the correct key is deterministic.
aes.test_key_note: Fixed 16-byte AES-128 test key. NOT a production secret. Never printed in test output.
aes.wrong_key_behavior: checkVersion calls codec.Unmarshal on the stored version bytes. Wrong-key AES decryption fails; errors.Join(ErrDifferentCodec, decryptErr) is returned.
